title: Comparison: TRAI vs RBI vs SEBI

blocks.content: Regulatory bodies like RBI, SEBI, and TRAI serve as autonomous market watchdogs ensuring stability, fair trade, and consumer protection across key sectors of the Indian economy.

items: RBI was established on the recommendation of the Hilton Young Commission in 1935 and nationalised in 1949.
SEBI was established as a non-statutory body in 1988 before gaining full statutory powers via the SEBI Act in 1992.
TRAI's adjudicatory powers were separated and transferred to TDSAT through an amendment in the year 2000.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RBI acts as the central bank regulating monetary policy, currency issuance, and banking operations under the RBI Act, 1934.
SEBI protects investor interests and regulates capital and securities markets under the SEBI Act, 1992.
TRAI regulates telecom services, tariffs, and spectrum management in India under the TRAI Act, 1997.
RBI and SEBI operate from Mumbai, whereas TRAI is headquartered in New Delhi.
